proof-statement-integrity.notes: AXIOM-BACKED + unsound: theorem gauge_coupling_uniqueness := gauge_coupling_uniqueness_axiom, and 'axiom gauge_coupling_uniqueness_axiom (S:SpectralRing) : forall phi psi, (exists p, phi r = p*r) -> (exists p', psi r = p'*r) -> exists lambda, phi r = lambda*psi r'. As stated this is FALSE when psi is mult-by-0 and phi is mult-by-nonzero (no lambda gives p*r = lambda*0*r). The corollary content is reasonable but the Lean is an unconditional axiom of an unsound proposition (lacks a nonzero/non-divisor hypothesis on psi).
